xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
1. The financial results of the Company have been prepared in accordance with the recognition and measurement principles laid down in the applicable Indian Accounting Standards notified under Section 133 of the Companies Act read with Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Rules, 2015 (as amended) and is in compliance with presentation and disclosure requirement of regulation 33 of SEBI LODR (Listing Obligation and Disclosure Requirements) regulation 2015 (as amended). The financial results have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors of the Company at their meetings held on October 19, 2024. The statutory auditor of the company have expressed unmodified opinion on these financial results.
2. The Company has one subsidiary by the name of Netweb Foundation which is not-for-profit company licensed under section 8 of the Companies Act, 2013 vide CIN U80902HR2022NPL103903. The profits of Section 8 Companies are not available for distribution as dividends to the shareholders, so the requirement of consolidation of financials don’t arise.
3. The figures for the quarter ended March 31, 2024 are the balancing figures between the audited figures in respect of the full financial year ended on that date and published year to date figures upto the third quarter of the said financial year.
4. According to Indian Accounting Standards (Ind-AS) 108 on “Operating Segment” the Company has only one business segment i.e. “Computer servers”.
5. The Company has granted 9,05,472 ESOPs to the employees and Key managerial personnel of the Company on January 21, 2023 after taking necessary approvals as disclosed in the Prospectus filed with SEBI. The ESOPs will vest over 1-3 years. Accordingly, the Company has recorded a cost of Rs. 32.13 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2024.
6. The proceeds from IPO were 1940.24 millions (net of issue related expenses including GST).

xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureNotesOnObjectsForWhi:
The Unutilized amount of Rs 113.14 million under object 1 Funding our Capital Expenditure requirements Category has been transferred to General Corporate Purpose vide board resolution dated March 24, 2025. This utilization towards GCP is in line with the disclosure provided in the offer document dated July 21, 2023 which states If the actual utilisation towards any of the Objects is lower than the proposed deployment such balance will be used towards general corporate purposes, provided that the total amount to be utilised towards general corporate purposes will not exceed 25% of the Gross Proceeds in accordance with Regulation 7(2) of the SEBI ICDR Regulations.



During the quarter ended March 31, 2025, the Company made a reimbursement of Rs. 4.93 million from the Monitoring account of the company, which is related to Object 1a i.e. Funding capital expenditure requirements - Civil construction of the building for the SMT line and interior development as the payment was initially processed through the Company's bank account (Indian Bank account).

Note 2: The Company has taken transferred Rs 0.65 crore from the current account of the company to the Monitoring Account of the company, on account of input tax credit that were paid from the net proceeds in the previous quarters which is towards object 1 Funding Capital Expenditure requirements. The reimbursements made are in line with the offer document which states that full amount to be paid from Net proceeds (inclusive of GST & Cess) for those invoices where input credit is not available.

^Payment of Rs 0.44 million was made in the previous quarter towards object-1, Funding Capital Expenditure requirements (ii) Purchase of equipment /machinery for new SMT Line which was inadvertently classified under Object-1Funding Capital Expenditure requirements (i) Civil construction of the building for the SMT Line and interior development. Corrective intra-category adjustments have been made in the quarter ending March 31, 2025.
